headline: Chest-high prime S swell — the standout of the day, go now.
today: This is the pick of the coast today: 3ft on the prime angle with only a light cross-on all day. It's short-period so it won't be world-class, but there's real size and it stays surfable dawn to dusk. Fish or shortboard if it's got any push, log it if it goes soft. Best around the morning tide before the afternoon cross-on adds texture. Worth the drive today if you can swing it.

daysToWatch.note: Short-period S bump to 2ft-plus with a light morning — clean-ish window before the afternoon cross-on. Second-best day out here.
Dawn NE cross-off keeps it clean on a fair-to-prime SSE angle, chest-high. Early only — onshore SE by afternoon.
